working_tree_secret_scan.scope: current repository working tree, including hidden files and excluding .git

exposed_interface_review.internal_transport: bounded local IPC contract; production socket and peer-credential plumbing not implemented

limitations: This is a targeted pattern scan, not a credential-provider or full Git-history scan.

Model and runtime binaries remain outside the repository and release. Their recorded digests were verified for development use, but they have not received a complete malware, provenance, or supply-chain audit.
The current repository test run is recorded separately; the complete certification security review on every retained physical tuple remains deferred.
